## Problem

## Proposal

What should change? Name the files or tools involved if you know them.

## Alternatives you considered

## Fit with the project principles

- [ ] Works with free data sources only (no paid API)
- [ ] Keeps the order path deterministic (no LLM places orders)
- [ ] Keeps paper trading as the default and does not weaken the live lock, the caps, the approval step or the kill switch
- [ ] Can be tested offline

## For strategy or signal ideas

How would you test the idea out of sample, which costs would you assume, and which result would make you drop it?

## Anything else

Links, papers, sketches or related issues.
